prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin across all kinds of changes, as no category has at least 2 tests yet.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to actual noise-corrected results.
No kind of change has been helpful yet, as no tests have won.
No clear effect was seen for sign_in, reorder changes.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -5.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -5.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Split Screen Redesign: Redesign the pet adoption screen into a side-by-side split layout clearly separating preset pets from custom photo uploads. (why: Adoption step drops to 60.9% conversion with long completion time, and users experience custom pet generation failures.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough Screen: Add a dedicated visual walkthrough screen before finishing that highlights essential shortcuts for hiding, moving, and talking to the pet. (why: Support mailbox received multiple tickets from users confused about how to hide or talk to their pet after setup.)
2: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Progress Timeline Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a story scroll layout with explicit generation stage progress indicators. (why: The waiting step has a high drop rate with median time of 201s and mean of 2336s.)
3: [choose_path, reorder] Story Sequence Onboarding Reorder: Reorder the onboarding sequence to present the pet story introduction before prompting for path selection. (why: choose_path has a 76.2% conversion and a long tail mean of 514s; engaging story context upfront improves initial momentum.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Account Persistence Clarification Copy: Update sign-in headline and body text to clearly explain that signing in permanently links and protects saved pet data. (why: Support received 8 emails reporting missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
5: [home, wait_info] Background Pet Prep Status Info: Display active progress updates and dynamic background readiness info on the waiting screen. (why: Users spend over 35 minutes on average in the waiting stage without clear feedback.)
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Clarity Hint: Add a prominent advice tip on the photo upload screen recommending well-lit, single-subject photos. (why: Users report custom pet generation failing or looking distorted.)
7: [home, notification] Pet Completion Audio Notification: Play a gentle notification chime and trigger desktop notifications when pet generation completes on the waiting screen. (why: Support notes pets fail to display or users miss when the app opens after long wait times.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Grid Layout for Path Selection: Switch choose_path layout to a compact grid presentation with high-visibility selection cards. (why: Path selection has a high mean time of 514s, indicating visual friction or indecision.)
